forms.form:
te zullen afbladderen
af te zullen bladderen

glosses: het in dunne laagjes loskomen van verf
To (cause to) come off in flakes.

examples.text: The apartment felt damp, and the paint on the walls was beginning to flake off.

glosses: To separate off from the main body, to move off to one side; as in troop movements on a parade ground or an organized retreat, or columns in a procession.
To remove (an outer layer or covering, such as clothing).
To drive away, especially at a fast speed.

examples.text: Perhaps the surface of the red brick, long unpainted, had scaled off a little more here and there.
